children: Summit said Akeso’s Phase III HARMONi-GI1 trial of ivonescimab plus chemo vs durvalumab plus chemo will be presented at ESMO 2026. Akeso previously reported interim OS superiority and PFS/ORR wins.
Phase III BTC data to ESMO 2026
High-profile slot signals potential clinical impact; can shape sentiment on ivonescimab’s prospects.
Overall survival win is the key efficacy bar; boosts perceived approvability and commercial odds.
PFS and ORR key endpoints met
Consistent efficacy across endpoints reduces risk that OS was a one-off.
Regional data may face external validity and regulatory scrutiny in US/EU.
Commercial upside for Summit depends on future regulatory success in its territories.

This is mid-cycle validation of ivonescimab’s profile, adding to prior topline signals and broader Phase III program. A detailed ESMO readout and subsequent regulatory feedback in Summit’s territories would be needed to become a larger catalyst.
